description: This file contains a Python class 'JiraService' that acts as a wrapper for interacting with Jira via an MCP client process. It includes methods for creating issues, transitioning issues, and adding comments, as well as configuration handling and a status mapping utility.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A service class that communicates with Jira through an MCP client, providing methods to create issues, transition their status, and add comments.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the JiraService instance, loading Jira MCP configuration.

methods.name: bool _is_enabled(self)
methods.description: Checks whether Jira MCP integration is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _run_tool(self, tool_name: str, args: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Executes the MCP client command with a JSON payload and handles the response.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_issue(self, *, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task")
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue with specified project key, summary, description, and issue type.

methods.name: bool transition_issue(self, *, issue_key: str, status_name: str)
methods.description: Transitions an existing Jira issue to a specified status.

methods.name: bool add_comment(self, *, issue_key: str, comment: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to an existing Jira issue.
